{{Top|leg}}
'''Generis base''' was the name of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] facility on [[Generis/Legends|Generis]]. It contained the [[Outer Rim Communications Center]], Sector Headquarters, and the sector's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base. The base lacked sufficient mechanics and spare parts, and, as it was not originally designed for starfighters, it had primitive maintenance facilities.<ref name="RASB">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> Generis base was located at the planet's southern pole, next to an outcrop of [[hiridui crystal]].<ref name="TLCSB 71">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> The base also contained a number of supply depots for the sector. The Communications Center was captured intact by Grand Admiral Thrawn<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> and later regained by the Republic, who did some further expansion on the site.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
